command: M=origin/main; P1=origin/claude/auto-video-editing-luxury-w9l6jp; P2=HEAD; echo "main $(git rev-parse --short $M)  pr1 $(git rev-parse --short $P1)  pr2 $(git rev-parse --short $P2)"; git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only $M $P2 >/dev/null; echo "PR2 into main: exit $?"; git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only $M $P1 >/dev/null; echo "PR1 into main: exit $?"; git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only $P1 $P2 | sed -n "2,20p"; T=$(git merge-tree --write-tree $M $P1) && C=$(git -c user.name=sim -c user.email=sim commit-tree $T -p $M -p $P1 -m sim) && git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only $C $P2 >/dev/null; echo "PR1 first, then PR2: exit $?"; T=$(git merge-tree --write-tree $M $P2) && C=$(git -c user.name=sim -c user.email=sim commit-tree $T -p $M -p $P2 -m sim) && git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only $C $P1 >/dev/null; echo "PR2 first, then PR1: exit $?"; echo "files changed by both PRs:"; comm -12 <(git diff --name-only $M...$P1 | sort) <(git diff --name-only $M...$P2 | sort)
